facts.claim: TallyPrime is Tally's flagship business management (accounting, inventory, GST) software; Tally says it enables nearly 2.5 million businesses worldwide.
Tally markets TallyPrime to retail shops, supermarkets and retail chains generally; its retail pages do not name mobile-phone or electronics retailers as a segment.

TallyPrime Silver (single user, single PC): Rs 750/month, Rs 2,138 for 3 months (list Rs 2,250, 5% off), Rs 8,100 for 12 months (list Rs 9,000, 10% off), all + 18% GST, auto-renewing and including TSS.
TallyPrime Silver lifetime (perpetual) licence: Rs 22,500 + 18% GST, including 1 year of TSS.
TallyPrime Gold (multi-user on multiple PCs): Rs 2,250/month, Rs 6,413 for 3 months (list Rs 6,750), Rs 24,300 for 12 months (list Rs 27,000), all + 18% GST, auto-renewing and including TSS.
TallyPrime Gold lifetime (perpetual) licence: Rs 67,500 + 18% GST, including 1 year of TSS.

After the first year, lifetime-licence owners renew Tally Software Services (updates and connected services) at Rs 4,500/year for Silver or Rs 13,500/year for Gold, + 18% GST (2-year: Rs 8,100 Silver, Rs 24,300 Gold).
A 7-day free trial is offered; no free plan is listed.
TallyPrime Cloud Access (hosted access via browser or virtual client) is priced at Rs 600 per user per month; on the buy page it is offered as + Rs 1,800 for 3 months with Silver.
TallyPrime Server (data server on top of a Gold licence for higher concurrency, for medium/large enterprises) costs Rs 2,70,000 + 18% GST.
TallyPrime has built-in batch tracking (F11 Features > Enable Batches), with batch, manufacturing and expiry dates; Tally's own pages read do not describe a dedicated IMEI or serial-number feature.
Tally's May 2026 inventory guide covers godowns, batches and expiry, and mentions electronics only as a user of batch tracking; it does not mention serial or IMEI tracking.
Serial-number tracking with warranty periods is sold as a third-party add-on, e.g. Antraweb's 'Serial Number Management for TallyPrime' (price not shown on its page).
No warranty tracking is described on Tally's own pages; the Antraweb third-party serial-number add-on offers supplier and customer warranty periods per serial.
Stock locations are handled as 'godowns' (a warehouse, shop floor or rack), with branch-wise reports and inter-godown transfers recorded via the Stock Journal voucher.
Tally's retail page says TallyPrime can centralise inventory control and consolidate financial data from all outlets, and manage multiple billing counters.
Since Release 3.0, one TallyPrime company can hold multiple GSTINs (e.g. branches in different states), with separate voucher series and GST returns per registration.
TallyPrime Server is positioned for 10+ simultaneous users and multi-branch operations consolidating to head office.

Tally sells a separate retail POS product, Shoper 9 (HO, POS and Distributor components, barcode, schemes/discounts, till management) that integrates with TallyPrime; its page does not mention serial/IMEI or loyalty.
TallyPrime supports direct upload/filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B reconciliation, IMS, connected e-invoicing and e-way bills, and TDS/TCS.
All Silver and Gold plans list e-invoicing and e-way bills as included.
TallyPrime is a full double-entry accounting system with Balance Sheet, P&L, banking reconciliation and connected banking.
TallyPrime Edit Log is a variant (same licence) where the audit trail cannot be disabled, built for MCA audit-trail compliance; in standard TallyPrime the edit log is optional.
Receivables are tracked bill-by-bill with credit periods, credit limits (with warnings), ageing, interest on overdues and bulk reminder letters by email or print.
Tally's retail page speaks of building loyalty through purchase patterns and promotions, but no loyalty points or rewards feature is described.

TallyPrime with WhatsApp (introduced in Release 4.0, needs valid TSS) sends invoices, delivery notes, reports, invoices with payment links/QR and overdue reminder letters, and can auto-send a voucher after saving.
WhatsApp needs a WhatsApp Business Account set up via Interakt with Meta business verification and approved templates; messages are paid from a wallet.

TallyPrime with WhatsApp costs Rs 1,300 per year (excl. GST, minimum 12 months) plus Meta per-conversation charges from a wallet (Rs 100 credit on activation; top-ups Rs 675 for Rs 500 credit or Rs 2,700 for Rs 2,000 credit).
WhatsApp limitations per Tally FAQ: no scheduling, no sending to groups, not from Tally Remote client.
TallyPrime is desktop software that keeps billing working without an internet connection.
Business reports can be viewed from a web browser on any device, including mobile; full use from anywhere requires the paid Cloud Access add-on (Windows, Linux, macOS listed).
In-product POS: a sales voucher type set 'Use for POS invoicing', barcode scanning, multi-mode payment (cash, card, cheque, gift voucher), POS register and POS printer formats.

Latest release is TallyPrime 7.1 (23 June 2026) with new invoice templates, improved IMS reconciliation, Schedule III statements and TallyIra AI document processing; 7.0 (Dec 2025) added scheduled auto-backup to TallyDrive and SmartFind.

Genuine strengths: very deep accounting and GST compliance (direct return filing, 2A/2B/IMS reconciliation, e-invoice, multi-GSTIN, MCA audit trail), low one-time lifetime price, works offline, huge installed base and CA/accountant familiarity, large partner and add-on (TDL) ecosystem.

notes: Correction to any older copy: the lifetime licence includes only 1 year of TSS; renewing costs Rs 4,500 (Silver) or Rs 13,500 (Gold) per year + GST. Rental Silver/Gold include TSS for as long as you pay. 'TallyPrime Edit Log' is a same-licence variant, not a separately priced product. WhatsApp is built into TallyPrime 4.0+ but is a paid subscription (Rs 1,300/yr) plus Meta message charges, and needs TSS. Many cheaper third-party 'Tally to WhatsApp' QR connectors exist; do not confuse them with the official service. A search result said Tally's help tells mobile dealers to use the IMEI as a batch number, but the page returned no such text when I fetched it, so it is not stated as fact. Shoper 9 is Tally's separate retail POS for chains; if the comparison page mentions 'Tally for retail chains', Shoper 9 is the closer competitor. Fetched pages were summarised by a tool; prices were checked against the raw HTML of buy-tally and tally-software-service.
